# Sttar: Social Archive

> Sttar is a free photo-sharing app for iPhone and Android. People post up to five photos a day to a personal calendar, share them with their friends, school, and Greek chapter, collect a stamp for every city they visit, and turn trips into albums. Over time it becomes an archive of their life. Made by Sttar Inc.

Key facts:
- Name: Sttar: Social Archive (often just "Sttar")
- Price: free
- Platforms: iOS (App Store) and Android (Google Play)
- Age rating: 13+
- Core features: up to five photos a day; calendar archive with a cover for each day and streaks; city stamps earned by being in a city; trip albums with photos, stamps, and a map; friends' photos newest first with no algorithm; school pages via student email verification; Greek chapter spaces; public or private days and trips
- Audience: friend groups, college students, Greek life chapters, travelers
- Contact: hello@sttar.com
